title.zh: Review清单：JDV 签核前查什么
title.en: Review checklist: what to inspect before JDV sign-off

subtitle.zh: 检查顺序比“随便放大看看”更可靠。
subtitle.en: An ordered review is more reliable than casually zooming around

body.zh: 1；产品名 / Revision /；生成日期；核对
body.en: 1 Product name / revision / generation date Verify

body.zh: 2；Die尺寸 / 方向/；镜像/ 阵列；核对
body.en: 2 Die size / orientation / mirroring / array Verify

body.zh: 3；Mask层数 /；Layer名称；核对
body.en: 3 Mask layer count / layer names Verify

body.zh: Clear / Dark Tone；核对
body.en: Clear / dark tone Verify

body.zh: 5；Frame / Kerf / Mark /；PCM / Dummy；核对
body.en: 5 Frame / kerf / marks / PCM / dummy Verify

body.zh: 6；Bias / Shrink /；OPC / Issue；核对
body.en: 6 Bias / shrink / OPC / issues Verify

body.zh: Reticle / Mask 版图示意；Die（芯片区）；功能版图所在区域
body.en: Reticle / mask layout example Die (chip area) Region containing functional layout

body.zh: Frame（框架）；承载与对准基准区域
body.en: Frame Support and alignment-reference region

body.zh: Kerf（切割道）；晶圆切割预留槽
body.en: Kerf (scribe lane) Reserved wafer-dicing lane

body.zh: Mark（对准标记）；用于对准与套刻
body.en: Mark (alignment mark) Used for alignment and overlay

body.zh: PCM（工艺控制标记）；工艺监控与补偿
body.en: PCM (process-control mark) Process monitoring and compensation

body.zh: Dummy（填充）；均匀密度与工艺稳定
body.en: Dummy (fill) Uniform density and process stability

body.zh: Tone（工艺极性）；Clear / Dark
body.en: Tone (process polarity) Clear / dark

body.zh: OPC（光学邻近校正）；关键边缘修正
body.en: OPC (optical proximity correction) Critical-edge correction

body.zh: 关键信息一致性；几何/层/标记检查
body.en: Consistency of key information Geometry / layer / mark checks

body.zh: 关键控制；版本唯一性；版本一致、来源清晰
body.en: Key controls Unique version Consistent version and clear provenance

body.zh: Mask完整性；层、标记、结构齐全
body.en: Mask completeness Complete layers, marks and structures

body.zh: 几何变换；方向、镜像、阵列正确
body.en: Geometric transforms Correct orientation, mirroring and array

body.zh: 工艺记录；参数、规则、日志完整
body.en: Process records Complete parameters, rules and logs

body.zh: 覆盖与效率；检查速度；覆盖度；检查速度与覆盖度；存在权衡
body.en: Coverage and efficiency Review speed Coverage Review speed and coverage involve a trade-off

body.zh: 高风险层需要更深；Review
body.en: High-risk layers need deeper review

body.zh: 常见风险；只看Die忽略Frame；Review错阶段；带未关闭Issue Release；版本混淆
body.en: Common risks Inspecting the die but ignoring the frame Reviewing the wrong data stage Releasing with open issues Version confusion

body.zh: 反馈闭环；Checklist；按顺序逐项核对
body.en: Feedback loop Checklist Verify sequentially item by item

body.zh: 关键截图；支持定位与复现
body.en: Key screenshots Support localization and reproduction

body.zh: Issue Log；记录与跟踪
body.en: Issue log Record and track

body.zh: Owner与关闭状态；责任明确、闭环确认
body.en: Owner and closure status Clear responsibility and confirmed closure

body.zh: 边界：Review项目会随工艺节点、Tone和Lithography策略变化。
body.en: Limit: review items vary with process node, tone and lithography strategy
